verdict.rationale: Alloy publishes an llms.txt docs index at developer.alloy.com/public/llms.txt, explicitly labeled "For AI agents", with per-page .md mirrors that carry per-endpoint OpenAPI fragments; the docs URLs themselves are .md pages. The probe 404 at the root /llms.txt does not contradict this, because the file lives under /public/. missing for 10: llms.txt not served at the conventional root path (root /llms.txt returns 404), no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
